subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-22 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's claim: 'the achievements in world culture can provide some basis for viewing this cycle as a cycle — which is to say, a point in time and nothing more.' (C)C-INFO (the concept of composite information) is crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics): the question is what composite-information produces when crossed with social-reality-dynamics — composite-information being the deeper field of world-cultural achievement against which this cycle should be measured. COS-P (cosmic particulars) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branch from the main line. VT-DY carries (R)TM (the reality of terminology, or terms of a definition) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). PROG-CONT carries INFO-DY (information dynamics) and (R)OBS (the reality of observation), and a *dashed* line from (R)OBS to PART (participation) amplifies some aspect of (R)OBS.
